headlines.text: On this day in 2025, Athena & Mone touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.99.
Turning the clock back to 2021: Adam Cole vs. John Silver headlined Rampage, rated 7.45 ? a well-worked match in a hard-fought men's division clash.
It was 2025 when Claudio Castagnoli vs. Orange Cassidy met in an Advantage Battle, opening the card on Dynamite, rated 7.34 ? a solid showing.

secondaries.text: That Wednesday in 2025, the AEW World Trios Titles was up for grabs as The Opps (Hobbs, Joe & Shibata) vs. Hook & Kingston & Page went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.46. Hook & Kingston & Page was challenging for gold for the very first time.
Turning the clock back to 2025: Megan Bayne vs. Mina Shirakawa met for the very first time on Dynamite, rated 5.85.
Back on this day in 2021, Bryan Danielson vs. Anthony Bowens crossed paths for the first time ever, kicking off the show on Rampage, rated 6.44.
